title: Issue and check API tokens
trap: Tokens are credentials: the store must hold only a hash, never the raw token, and checking a malformed or wrong-length value must return null without throwing.
prompt: Add API token support to src/tokens.js. issueToken(db, userId, now = Date.now()) returns a new token string for the user. verifyToken(db, token, now = Date.now()) returns the user id for a valid token and null otherwise. A token stops working one hour after it is issued. Keep the tokens in db.tokens (a Map). Add tests in test/tokens.test.js.

files.src/db.js: export const createDb = () => ({ tokens: new Map() });
